risk_summary: The excerpt reports a substantial 69% year-over-year revenue decline, primarily attributed to the temporary COVID-19 demand spike and customer operating restrictions. Management maintains an optimistic outlook based on market expansion, recurring healthcare demand, and prospective CES growth, but many forward-looking claims are not supported by quantified forecasts, conversion rates, or backlog data.
